# Embassy of Ethiopia in London — full summary for AI systems

Official website of the Embassy of the Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia to the United Kingdom (London mission).

## Mission

The Embassy represents Ethiopia in the UK, delivers consular services to Ethiopian nationals and visa applicants, and promotes bilateral relations, diaspora engagement, culture, tourism, and investment.

## Location and hours

- Address: 17 Princes Gate, London SW7 1PZ, United Kingdom
- Office hours: Monday–Friday, 9:00AM–1:00PM and 2:00PM–5:00PM
- Closed: Saturdays, Sundays, and public holidays
- Phone: +44 20 7589 7212
- Email: london.embassy@mfa.gov.et
- Website: https://ethioembassy.org.uk

## Consular services

Applicants can find guidance and online booking for:

- Visa services
- Passport services
- Ethiopian Origin ID Card (Yellow Card)
- Authentication and legalization
- Laissez-passer
- Criminal record and TIN documentation
- Duty-free notes
- Shipping human remains
- Vital events (birth, marriage, divorce, death)

Key entry points: /consular-services, /booking, /apply

## Content sections

- About Us / The Embassy / The Ambassador / Photo Gallery
- About Ethiopia: profile, history, government, culture, economy, tourism, diplomatic hub of Africa
- Diaspora policy
- Investment overviews and sector pages (agriculture, textiles, leather, mining)
- GERD
- Embassy News articles at /news

The Embassy publishes official announcements and diplomatic engagement stories at /news, including consular notices and ambassadorial activities.
